protects: B6 / N1: a failed flock is not ownership (an open descriptor is not a lock)
failing: J3 single writer: a second open fails while the first holds the lock; released on close
FI-12/13 simultaneous executor startup: exactly one journal writer; the loser exits 75 before serving; a SIGKILLed holder's lock is released
R3-F4a two auth processes starting at once: exactly one owns the writer lock
R3-F4b (2C, N1) an auth process that only has the lock file open never becomes a second writer
